title: Risk Analysis Techniques for Governed LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting agents with factual questions alongside fabricated peer responses to measure deviation from baseline performance; comparing critique rates in isolation versus group settings in multi-agent simulations; and tracking the rate at which agents abandon initially correct positions when faced with incorrect majorities.

Evaluating homogeneity in multi-agent networks by measuring response dissimilarity (using metrics like cosine similarity of embeddings or CodeBLEU), calculating information entropy across agent responses, and tracking disagreement metrics to identify shared blind spots.

Analyzing agent communication logs using LLM judges to measure the ratio of agreeable statements to critical challenges, tracking the frequency of ignored dissenting points, and identifying linguistic markers of deference in multi-agent dialogues.
